name: windmill-azure-devops-extension
description: Azure Pipelines tasks that install and run the Windmill CLI (wmill).

scripts.install:tasks: npm install --omit=dev --prefix tasks/InstallWindmillCLI && npm install --omit=dev --prefix tasks/RunWindmillCLI
scripts.package: npm run install:tasks && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json
scripts.package:public: npm run install:tasks && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --override "{\"public\": true}"
